posts.message:
The smoker’s working on a little team spirit today! 🔥📣

We’ve got pork butts smoking for pulled pork for the Barto Hill Brawlers 8U Cheer Squad’s end-of-season get-together!

Only a few games left, and we’re excited to help celebrate the squad and the season together—with plenty of pulled pork to go around. 💪

Let’s finish strong, Brawlers! 📣

#RoswellFamilyFarm #BartoHillBrawlers #8UCheer #CommunitySupport
Sending Chickens next week let us know what you want before it’s final

Dinner’s working while we are. 🐷🍂

Tonight at the Roswell house, we’ve got a pork butt roast in the Crock-Pot with Roswell’s Pot Roast seasoning, onions, chopped garlic cloves, baby carrots and butter!

A little prep, then back to the day while dinner cooks. That’s our kind of family meal—and we’ll show you how it turns out tonight. 🍽️

Want to make your own? Head to our Pork Cuts Orders page and request a Butt Roast. We’ll confirm availability, your final total based on its actual weight, and pickup arrangements.

👉 https://roswellfamilyfarm.com/pork-cuts-orders.html

Follow Roswell Family Farm for more from our farm and kitchen in Salisbury/Dolgeville, NY. 🛸
